description: This file defines a template class 'SingleClientServer' for managing a WebSocket server that handles a single client connection. It includes methods to start and stop the server, and manages connection callbacks. The class is designed to be inherited and customized for specific server implementations.

classes.name: SingleClientServer
classes.description: A template class for a WebSocket server managing a single client connection, providing start and stop functionalities.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WebSocket server on a specified port, setting up connection callbacks.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the WebSocket server and closes active connections.
